_what_this_is: Push receipts for this repository recovered from GH Archive, a permanent third-party mirror of GitHub's public event stream. These cover commits whose events GitHub's own API no longer serves. 'received_by_github_utc' is GitHub's server-side arrival time as recorded at the time of the push; it is not settable by the repository owner, and these records are held by a third party.
_how_to_verify: Each entry names the exact GH Archive file it came from in 'source_file'. Download that file independently and search it for the event_id below. Nothing in this repository has to be trusted.
